name: Frog with lá lốt
summary: Frog stir-fried with the skin on, finished with young lá lốt.
origin: Củ Chi, on the Người Lao Động account of 6 Mar 2017. The paper says kitchens and tourism grounds in the district serve it.
howToEat: Stir-fry field or garden frog in four pieces, skin on, and add young lá lốt at the end.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Frog with lá lốt in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Frog stir-fried with the skin on and finished with young lá lốt.
